title: UpsertTaxonomyCode
description: A code in a structured taxonomy or reference list — CPV (procurement), NUTS (geo), FIRDS (instruments), MIC (markets), exchange identifiers, etc. Identified by (system, code) so different schemes can coexist without collision; a flat key would force unnatural namespacing on the producers. Sinks materialise per-system labels and parent_code → CHILD_OF edges if the taxonomy is hierarchical.

label_lang.description: BCP-47 / ISO-639 language tag for `label` when set.

parent_code.description: Parent code in the same `system` (hierarchical taxonomies only).
